## 席位核对 — REWORK · L1 · head `f781168fef26fb59f84146acc04c93b9d7c0fd17` · 2026-11-25T22:16Z

PR #37347 → #37269 (zone a4-S). Final report 7174275022, zone finalize 7175456635. I checked everything against GitHub and my own runs, not against the report.

### Checklist

- **Shape** (`l1-face.mjs --pr 37347`: CLEAN, 13 items, none flagged). The PR is an open draft against `main`. The first line is `Fixes #37269`, and no closing keyword binds any other card. Merging delivers the whole card, so `Fixes` is right. There is no releases path and no NUL suspect.
- **Card fit, on every path the card names.**
  - The Packages page per-draft link (`PackagesPage.tsx:1335`, `APP/metadata/TYPE/NAME?review=1`) is pinned. The test renders the real `PackageDetailSheet`, asserts the href, clicks the link, and follows Setup's redirect onto the real `StudioMetadataArea` `~all` leg. The real matrix is registered as the type's `EditPage`.
  - The chat's 「Review N change(s)」 path is pinned through `setupMetadataStudioPath(item, 'review=1')`. That is the same call `DraftReviewNavigator` makes at `AppContent.tsx:286`, which I checked at head.
  - Studio's `StudioPermissionSetPage` on the package leg is pinned in `StudioPermissionSetPage.fullScreen-36905`.
  - Setup's routed `PermissionMatrixEditPage` is the `~all` leg. `ResourceEditPage`'s dispatcher hands the type's `EditPage` the route whenever `!createMode`, so the matrix and `MetadataResourceEditPageImpl` are never mounted together. No page runs two `?review=1` arrivals.
  - The CONTROLs (no `?review=1`, so no review and no extra draft read), the no-draft case, and the flow and object links (`StudioMetadataArea.routes-28561`, unchanged and green) are all present. Done-when, "both producers' links on a permission-set draft show what the draft changes", is met.
- **The extraction preserves `ResourceEditPage`'s behaviour** (my own read of the diff):
  - The hook's effect deps are `[reviewParam, enabled, loading, hasDraft]`, where `enabled = !createMode`. That is the old `[reviewParam, createMode, loading, hasDraft]`.
  - `reload` and `open` are the same two setters.
  - The callbacks and query reach the effect through a ref. The refresh effect is declared before the arrival effect in the same hook, so it runs first in the same commit and the arrival effect sees that render's values, as the old closure did.
  - The ref, the bump, the wait-for-settle and the `replace` drop of `review` follow the same sequence.
  - `DraftReviewSheet` renders the old `Sheet` markup unchanged (same classes, same two keys, `DraftReviewPanel`), with the same `published={layered?.effective ?? null}` and `draft={draft}`.
  - `setSearchParams` left `ResourceEditPage` together with its only use. Both type-check programs are green in CI.
  - Existing suites at head, run by me: every `ResourceEditPage.*` suite plus every suite that reads `?review=1` or the review panel. That is 74 files: `Test Files 74 passed (74)`, `Tests 600 passed (600)`.
- **Matrix arrival.**
  - `reload` sets `reviewReading` and bumps the nonce in one batch, so the hook never reads a stale `hasDraft` with `loading` false.
  - A refused draft read gives `answer: null`, so no review opens.
  - `MetadataClient.layered` answers a 404 as an all-null envelope (`PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx`, the objectui#7611 comment), so a never-published set is reviewed against `null`, as on the generic page.
  - Only another read failure (for example, a name two packages hold, read without a package) yields no review.
  - The matrix already used `useSearchParams`, so the hook adds no Router dependency. The matrix is never mounted in create mode (`CreatePage` is separate), so `enabled: true` is right.
- **Translation keys.** `released-keys-removed.mjs --tag @object-ui/i18n@18.6.0` ran read-only against head and against base `a182fbe3`. Both report `total 77`, and the removed-key groups are identical. The PR removes no released key. No catalogue file is in the diff, and the sheet uses two existing keys (`designer.draftReview.title`, `designer.canvas.reviewVsPublished`). No new keys, so nothing to complete.
- **Declarations and changeset.**
  - `readClause2Line` on the card's only and newest `Claim:` comment (7172764928), the PR body and the changeset all return `{kind: declared, value: no, arm: null}`.
  - `readMetadataProtocolLine` returns `none` on all three, so the claim matches the body.
  - `Clause-②: no` is correct. `@object-ui/app-shell` is `private: true`, its only export is `.`, and no `index.ts` re-exports `DraftReviewSheet`, `useDraftReviewArrival` or `DRAFT_REVIEW_*`. No props change.
  - `none` gives `patch`, which is what `.changeset/37269-permission-set-review-link.md` says for `@object-ui/app-shell`. A root `.changeset/` file for app-shell follows the repo convention (257 such files on main).
  - I checked the changeset sentence by sentence against the diff, and all nine sentences hold, including "No locale keys, props or entry exports change".
- **Pins at head** (my run, throwaway worktree, deps built with CI's `ui-deps` turbo closure). The 4 pinned suites plus the two redirect suites (`setupMetadataRedirect`, `AppContent.setupMetadataStudio-28578`): `Test Files 6 passed (6)`, `Tests 201 passed (201)`.
- **Ablations** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each anchor 1→0, each restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty, over the 4 pinned suites, 76 tests):

  | Mutation | Result |
  | --- | --- |
  | A1: matrix arrival `enabled: true` changed to `false` | 5 red: both Studio review pins, both producer pins, the no-draft address pin. Both CONTROLs green. |
  | A3: generic page `enabled: !createMode` changed to `false` | 2 red: detailTabs `?review=1 opens the review and is consumed`, and its CONTROL |
  | A4: the hook's `next.delete(DRAFT_REVIEW_PARAM)` removed | 6 red: detailTabs ×2, Studio address pin, both producer pins, the no-draft pin |
  | A5 (mine, not in the report): matrix `hasDraft` forced to `false` | 4 red: both producer pins, Studio review pin, Studio editing pin. The no-draft pin and both CONTROLs stay green. |

  The dev's A1, A3 and A4 counts reproduce exactly.
- **Check-runs at head.** 51 runs: 38 success, 13 skipped (all expected-skip per `l1-face`), 0 failed, 0 pending, and no legacy commit status. Lint & Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check, Lint UI, Type Check UI, Test UI, Check Changeset and Governed Surface Queue Guard are all `success`.
- **Merge state.**
  - `git merge-tree --write-tree` against origin/main `134b71db` is clean (exit 0). No file is shared with main's 7 new commits.
  - #37338 (`PackagesPage.tsx`) and #37341 landed in between and touch neighbouring files only.
  - **Overlap with #37351 (`c9c1d9e4`) and #37348 (`7e57a1c7`):** none of their files are in this diff. The pairwise `merge-tree` on top of main+#37347 is clean for both.
  - Both PRs touch components this PR's new test renders: `PackageCustomizationsPanel` (inside `PackageDetailSheet`) and `StudioAreaAppOpen` (`StudioAreaAppGate` around `AreaItemOpen`). So I built a local tree of main + #37347 + #37351 + #37348, rebuilt the deps closure on it, and ran the 6 suites above plus `PackagesPage.installedAppsUpdates-34722` and `StudioAreaAppOpen-36906`: `Test Files 8 passed (8)`, `Tests 264 passed (264)`.
- **K = 7** (origin/main `134b71db`). It was 6 at the zone's finalize 2026-11-25T21:42Z; #37350 has landed since, and it is a runtime test. Under 15, so no merge of main is owed before queueing.
- **Contract review:** not owed. `Clause-②: no` without a `(narrowing)` arm, no `packages/spec/src/**`, and no governed path among the 7 files. Not Tier H: under 3,000 lines and not governed. CI plus this seat read is the whole review.
- **Report evidence.** Every gate reading in the report names `f781168f`. The two local timeouts (`check:query-options-erasure`, `check:type-check-debt`) are NOT MEASURED locally, and their CI jobs are success at head. The report's `mcp_calls` are all reads.

### Findings

- S1 (should-fix) — The 维护者速读 understates the risk in 「出错会怎样」. It says 「矩阵编辑和其他类型的审阅不受影响」. After this PR, every other type's `?review=1` arrival runs through the shared `useDraftReviewArrival`, and every other type's review sheet renders through `DraftReviewSheet`. A defect there would break the review link for every type, not only the permission set's. That outcome is what the extraction preserves (pinned by A3/A4), not a worst case it rules out. In the same bullet set, 「在软件包页点某个权限集草稿的「审阅」」 names a label the page does not show: the per-draft link reads `TYPE · NAME` (`PackagesPage.tsx:1340`). Body-only fix by the zone before landing, no head move. Suggested 「出错会怎样」: 「最坏情况是审阅链接打开后面板不弹出或内容不对：权限集之外，其他类型的审阅也改走同一段共享代码（已有测试钉住，行为不变）；矩阵编辑不受影响。纯界面改动，直接撤回即可。」 and 「点某个权限集草稿的链接」 for the first bullet.
- N1 — The "What changes" bullet says the arrival reads the draft "at the address its load reads". That holds for the published (layered) read only. The matrix's load reads a draft at the door's `packageId` alone (`PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx:1159`), while the arrival reads it at `layeredPackageId`, else by name. The Acceptance notes already state the cross-package consequence. Wording only; nothing owed.
- N2 — On the cross-package leg, where both producers land, the matrix under the sheet shows the published set while the sheet shows the draft. The matrix behaved this way before this PR, and the Acceptance notes record it. It is the more meaningful gap behind the parity question (below), not a defect of this PR.
- N3 — The chat pin re-states `DraftReviewNavigator`'s navigate call rather than mounting `AppContent`. The call is the same shape as `AppContent.tsx:286`, and the redirect is pinned separately in `AppContent.setupMetadataStudio-28578`. Accepted.
- N4 — `reviewRead` is not keyed on `name`. If one matrix instance were reused across sets, a stale read would remain, but it is closed. A new arrival sets `loading` before it reads `hasDraft`, so no stale review opens. Harmless.

### Parity ux card (zone Q1 A)

I agree with A: no reopen chip in this PR, and no parity card filed now.

- The card's Done-when is the arrival, and it is met.
- There is no measured pull for a chip on the matrix header (startup no-diffusion axis).
- On Studio's package leg, the surface's Changes panel and pending count already reach the package's drafts.
- The producers' links stay where they were, so the review can be opened again.

If a card is filed later, scope it to the cross-package leg (N2): the matrix there shows the published set under a draft review, and that, not a missing chip, is what a user would trip on. That calls for a design ruling, so a needs-user-decision card, not a ux chip card.

### Landing

- The zone lands it after the S1 body edit (no head move; the seat then posts a same-head delta ACCEPT). K = 7 < 15: no merge of main first. Changeset present. Not Tier H, and no contract review owed.
